points.point: Fed is providing liquidity to facilitate orderly functioning of financial markets amid market stress
points.quote: The Federal Reserve is providing liquidity to facilitate the orderly functioning of financial markets.
paraphrases: Fed is providing liquidity to support orderly functioning of financial markets.
Federal Reserve injecting liquidity to keep markets functioning smoothly.
Fed acts to supply liquidity and maintain orderly market functioning.
decoys: The Federal Reserve is withdrawing liquidity to tighten financial conditions.
The Federal Reserve is providing liquidity to facilitate orderly functioning of the housing market.

points.point: Statement references the FOMC's fed funds target rate of 5-1/4 percent
points.quote: the Federal Open Market Committee's target rate of 5-1/4 percent
paraphrases: Fed funds target rate remains 5-1/4% amid the liquidity operations.
Statement cites the FOMC target rate of 5-1/4 percent.
decoys: The FOMC cut its target rate to 5 percent to ease market strains.
The FOMC's target rate is referenced at 5-1/2 percent.
patterns: ((?<!\d)5(?!\d)[\-\s]?(?<!\d)1(?!\d)/(?<!\d)4(?!\d)|(?<!\d)5\.25(?!\d)|(?<!\d)525(?!\d)\s?(bp|basis points)).{0,80}(target rate|federal funds rate|fed funds rate)

points.point: Discount window is available as a source of funding
points.quote:
the discount window is available
as a source of funding.
paraphrases: The discount window remains available as a funding source for banks.
Fed noted the discount window is open as a backstop funding source.
Discount window available to institutions needing funding.
decoys: The term auction facility is available as a source of funding.
The discount window is temporarily closed to new borrowers.

points.point: Unusual funding needs stem from dislocations in money and credit markets
points.quote: depository institutions may experience unusual funding needs because of dislocations in money and credit markets
paraphrases: Fed noted banks may face unusual funding needs amid money-market dislocations.
Depository institutions could see unusual funding needs due to credit market strains.
Unusual funding needs cited as a result of turmoil in money and credit markets.
decoys: Depository institutions may experience unusual funding needs because of a government shutdown.
Depository institutions are experiencing normal, seasonal funding needs with no market stress.
patterns: (?:(?:dislocat\w*|disrupt\w*|strain\w*|turmoil|stress).{0,80}(?:money and credit markets|credit markets?|money[\-\s]?markets?)|(?:money and credit markets|credit markets?|money[\-\s]?markets?).{0,80}(?:dislocat\w*|disrupt\w*|strain\w*|turmoil|stress))
not_patterns: normal.{0,80}funding needs|seasonal funding needs|no market stress

points.point: Fed will supply reserves as necessary through open market operations to keep fed funds trading near target
points.quote: The Federal Reserve will provide reserves as necessary through open market operations to promote trading in the federal funds market
paraphrases: Fed will supply reserves as needed via open market operations to keep fed funds near target.
Federal Reserve to conduct open market operations, providing reserves as necessary.
Fed pledged flexible reserve provision through OMOs to support the fed funds rate.
decoys: The Federal Reserve will drain reserves through open market operations.
The Federal Reserve will provide a fixed, one-time injection of reserves through the discount window.
